releases.name: v1.2.1 (ACID support, GDPR, Golang stdlib support and improved SQL compatibility)

commits.message:
feat: add multiple databases support

1. Multiple databases in one immudb instance, database list, database create command
2. User permissions per database, read, readwrite, admin, user create, user permision and user list command
3. Sysadmin user for user management and database creation
4. Update immuadmin and immuclient to use multiple database and user management features
5. Maintenence flag to override auth and allow full access to immudb
6. Change directory structure to keep all databases under /data directory
7. One Corruption Checker for all databases
8. Updated Auditor on immugw and immuclient to check on multiple databases

Co-authored-by: Valentin Padurean <912518+padurean@users.noreply.github.com>

Fix ineffectual assignments (#525)

This is a tougher PR to review, I'm sorry. I fully understand if you reject it
and approach this from a different angle. However I've stumbled upon a whole
range of ineffectual assignments in your code.

Most of them were assignments to an error variable, but missing the actual error
check. In the various test cases, I've tried to stick to whatever was the convention
in the particular test: require.NoError, require.Nil, direct err check.

I suggest you want to annotate a bunch of them. There were too many here for me
to do this in a reasonable fashion in this PR.

Should you intentionally skip these checks, I would recommend omitting the assignment
as well, as this clearly states an intention to future readers/reviewers.
